description: This file defines an abstract integration test case class for the Twig templating engine, which provides helpers to run and manage integration tests involving rendering templates with various configurations.

classes.name: Twig\Test\IntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending PHPUnit's TestCase, designed to facilitate execution of various integration tests for Twig templates, including setup of environments and handling of test cases with fixtures and expected outputs.

methods.name: getFixturesDir
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving fixtures directory; throws exception if not implemented.

methods.name: getFixturesDirectory
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the fixtures directory path.

methods.name: getRuntimeLoaders
methods.description: Returns an array of runtime loaders; by default, an empty array.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig extensions; default is empty.

methods.name: getTwigFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigFilter objects; default is empty.

methods.name: getTwigFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigFunction objects; default is empty.

methods.name: getTwigTests
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigTest objects; default is empty.

methods.name: testIntegration
methods.description: Runs an integration test with provided parameters, comparing actual output with expected results.

methods.name: testLegacyIntegration
methods.description: Runs a legacy style integration test, marked with '--legacy.test' files.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Discovers test cases by reading fixture files from the fixtures directory, parsing test definitions and expected outputs.

methods.name: getLegacyTests
methods.description: Retrieves legacy test cases, likely for backward compatibility.

methods.name: doIntegrationTest
methods.description: Executes a specified test case with all environment setup, handling exceptions, deprecations, and output comparisons.

methods.name: parseTemplates
methods.description: Parses template definitions from fixture files, returning an array of templates keyed by filename.
